prompt.en: On May 10, an operator realizes that an April 18 mailing-address change was never reported. That same morning, an inspector asks for the certificate record. Which response plan applies the two different clocks without inventing a renewal step?

text.en: Send the address update before the address-change window closes, answer the inspector request on its shorter clock, and leave certificate renewal out of the plan.
Renew the certificate first, then wait for the address update because inspection requests pause record duties.
Treat the address update and inspector request as one identical deadline because both mention certificate records.
Ignore the address record if the station can still be reached by forwarded mail.

explanation.en: Rules combined: B-001-002-002, B-001-002-003, B-001-002-005. Lifetime certificate validity does not remove record duties; the address update and inspector production rules have different timing.

prompt.en: A registration note says: 'ISED office sitting today, disability-related delivery request, and later qualification plans after Basic.' Which edit keeps all three rules in their lanes?

text.en: Do not add an exam-office charge, keep required examination portions in the accommodated delivery, and schedule later amateur qualifications only after Basic is issued.
Apply the accredited-examiner cost row to the office sitting because both are examinations.
Use the delivery request as permission to remove a required section from the examination.
Let later qualifications be written before the Basic path is complete if accommodation notes are present.

explanation.en: Rules combined: B-001-022-002, B-001-022-004, B-001-004-002, B-001-004-004. The fee setting, accommodation limits, and qualification sequence are separate rows that all have to pass.

prompt.en: An Advanced-qualified amateur drafts an event plan that would use a non-amateur service channel and include a deliberately false situation report as a training cue. What should a reviewer decide?

text.en: Reject the plan because the amateur qualification does not supply the other service authority, and the knowingly false traffic is a separate problem.
Approve the plan if the operator holds Advanced, because that makes service boundaries and message truthfulness optional during drills.
Approve the channel if the false report is brief and corrected later in the net.
Fix only the channel list; false training traffic is outside the radio rules once everyone knows it is practice.

explanation.en: Rules combined: B-001-004-006, B-001-003-001, B-001-003-007. Advanced amateur authority stays inside the amateur service, and false traffic is not cured by being part of an exercise.
